title: derivedExtUnit transport
statement: Let E:C≃A and T:B≃D be exact equivalences, U:A→B and V:C→D exact additive, and ρ:E⋙U⋙T≅V. If a∈Ext^n(X,U(EH)) is a DerivedExtUnit [def-sp-derived-scalar-ext-unit], a source isomorphism c:TX≅F and a class b∈Ext^n(F,VH) satisfy T(a)ρ_H=c b, then b is a V-derived Ext unit.

source.place: Derived reduction, finite coefficient extension and canonical comparison paragraphs

proof.text: Transport the universal Hom bijections along the two derived equivalences and the derived square isomorphism. Exact-functor single and shift coherence identifies the transported unit. The assumed Ext equation identifies this unit with b, including its positive shift and the prescribed source isomorphism.

theorem derivedExtUnit_transport (ρ₀ : E ⋙ U ⋙ T ≅ V)
    (X : B) (H : C) (F : D) (c : T.obj X ≅ F) (n : ℕ)
    (a : Ext.{wEB} X (U.obj (E.obj H)) n) (b : Ext.{wED} F (V.obj H) n)
    (hab : (a.mapExactFunctor T).comp (Ext.mk₀ (ρ₀.hom.app H)) (add_zero n) =
      (Ext.mk₀ c.hom).comp b (zero_add n))
    (h : U.DerivedExtUnit X (E.obj H) n a) : V.DerivedExtUnit F H n b
